abilities.name: All Eyes on Me
abilities.description: Once per round, when an allied Digimon within 3 spaces of your partner Digimon would take damage, your partner Digimon may take that damage instead. The damage is taken exactly as the original target would have taken it. It is not reduced or increased by your partner Digimon's own stats, resistances, or other abilities unless a specific ability says otherwise.

abilities.name: Shrug It Off
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon takes damage redirected by All Eyes on Me, reduce that damage by your Friendship rank.

abilities.name: Bigger Spotlight
abilities.description: All Eyes on Me's range increases from 3 spaces to 6 spaces.

abilities.name: Taunt
abilities.description: As a Basic Action, every opposing Digimon within range must attack your partner Digimon. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Better Than Fine
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon uses All Eyes on Me, the allied Digimon who would have taken the damage is healed for half that amount instead.

abilities.name: Hype Squad
abilities.description: Once per encounter, restore Hope equal to your Friendship rank to one other allied Tamer.
